Exercise A

The vocabulary list

These are all 42 words. Nothing else is tested, here or in the test — read them once, then start Exercise B.

WordWhat it means
G'daythe Australian way of saying hello
youth hostela cheap place where young travellers can sleep
to gleamto shine softly
clustera small group of things close together
giantextremely large
seashellthe hard cover of a small sea animal
to overhearto hear something by accident, not on purpose
ownerthe person something belongs to
terracea flat area outside a house where you can sit
snakea long reptile with no legs
air ambulancean aircraft that takes ill or injured people to hospital
satellitea machine sent into space to send signals back
to go offto leave a place
on one's ownwith nobody else
bushwalkingwalking in the Australian countryside for pleasure
box jellyfisha square-shaped jellyfish whose sting can kill
marine stingerthe Australian name for any stinging sea creature
to net offto close an area with a net
to be likelyto probably happen
rip currentwater that pulls swimmers away from the beach
to be swept out to seato be carried away from the shore by the water
comfortingmaking a worried person feel better
safetybeing free from danger
to call offto stop or cancel something you planned
riskthe chance that something bad happens
spokespersona person who speaks officially for a group
associationan organised group of people with a shared aim
survivalstaying alive in a dangerous situation
climaticto do with the weather in a region
mostlyin most cases; usually
interiorthe inland part of a country, away from the coast
to show sb aroundto take someone through a place and explain it
barbiethe Australian word for a barbecue
to serveto give food or drink to someone
to pickto take fruit or flowers from a plant by hand
litterrubbish left lying in a public place
tracka rough path through the countryside
to disturbto interrupt someone or something
sitea place where something important happens or stands
to damageto harm something so it no longer works well
lizarda small reptile with four legs and a long tail
deadlyable to kill you
